customer.business: REPAIHUB: online service that moves money from an Indian NRO account to a Canadian bank account, with the Indian tax forms and CA certificate handled
customer.target: Indian-origin adults living in Canada (PRs, new citizens with OCI, long-term work-permit holders) who hold savings in an Indian NRO account and want some or all of it in Canada
customer.where: Canada-wide, mostly the GTA, Greater Vancouver, Calgary/Edmonton, Montreal, Ottawa

segments.name: Property seller / inheritor with a lump sum (₹20L-₹1Cr waiting in NRO)
Settled mid-career professional with old FDs, rent or savings in NRO (₹5L-₹20L)
Newer immigrant (PR < 5 yrs) with modest NRO balance (under ₹5L)
Retiree / parent-age with Indian pension or rental income (₹3L-₹15L a year)

behaviours.name: Trusts only big banks
behaviours.how: Uses their Indian bank's NRI desk or a branch; suspicious of new apps holding large sums.

behaviours.name: Family-network fixer
behaviours.how: Has a relative or friend in India who 'handles things', including informal money swaps.

behaviours.name: Price comparer
behaviours.how: Compares Wise, Remitly and bank rates to the paisa before moving money.

behaviours.name: Busy, pays for convenience
behaviours.how: Will pay to not deal with forms, CAs, time zones or a trip to India.

behaviours.name: Procrastinator
behaviours.how: Money has sat in NRO for years; keeps meaning to deal with it 'on the next trip'.

behaviours.name: Asks the WhatsApp group first
behaviours.how: Acts only after people in their community group or temple/association vouch for something.

behaviours.name: Tax-anxious
behaviours.how: Worried about Indian TDS, Canadian reporting (T1135) and doing something wrong; wants a CA involved.

habits: you visit India roughly once every two years
your NRO account is with SBI and you haven't logged in for months
you are in three family WhatsApp groups and one community group
you sold (or are about to sell) a flat in India
you use Wise or Remitly to send money to your parents
you file your Canadian taxes with an accountant from your community
your parents in India help you with bank paperwork
you watch Indian finance YouTube channels about NRI rules

pitch:
REPAIHUB Safe Passage: your Indian NRO savings in your Canadian bank account, without visiting a branch in India. Works with your existing Indian bank.
We file Form 145 (formerly 15CA) and our partner Chartered Accountant certifies Form 146 (formerly 15CB). Every transfer starts with a free 15-minute call with that CA to confirm your tax position before anything moves. Transfers are executed by our partner, an RBI-authorised (AD Category-I) Indian bank, named on every receipt. REPAIHUB is a FINTRAC-registered Money Services Business (registration number on our site). Live status tracking, and a named Canadian support person who answers on Canadian hours.
Flat fees, nothing up front — our fee is taken only when your money arrives: Essential (up to ₹5 lakh) CAD $79 · Standard (₹5L–₹25L, CA certificate included) CAD $199 · Lump-Sum Concierge (₹25L to the USD 1M yearly limit, for property sales and inheritances) CAD $499. Currency conversion at the partner bank's published rate, shown before you confirm; no extra margin from us.
Guarantee: if your bank rejects our paperwork we redo it free, and if the money is not in your account within 5 business days of your documents being accepted, we refund our fee.
Founding 100 customers: Standard at CAD $149. You also get a year-end summary of your transfers for your Canadian accountant.
Example: moving ₹10 lakh (about CAD $15,900) costs CAD $199 (or $149 as a founding customer).
(Panel note for the four price answers: give each as the total fee in CAD you would pay to move ₹10 lakh.)
